posts.title: Patch notes: Alpha 0.3.5
posts.excerpt: New: Startracker, Patriot, Piranha and 15 more. Updated: Rhino, Starflier, Defender and 5 more. Removed: Adv. Debilitator Turret, Adv. Ripper Turret, Adv. Skyrail Turret and 67 more. 9 bugfixes.
posts.body:
**New and changed in the [wiki](#/wiki)**

- New ship **[Startracker](#/wiki/ships/startracker)**: Startracker afterburner: smaller nozzle with a metal rim painted from the pods' nozzles; engine FX mouth and burner plate fill a rectangular nozzle (FLBell rect).
- New ship **[Patriot](#/wiki/ships/patriot)**: Patriot canopy panes as glass, the Rhino rebuilt, a new pilot starts landed on Manhattan.
- New ship **[Piranha](#/wiki/ships/piranha)**: The Dagger (bw_fighter) redesigned from Alex's Tripo AI model, with its two paints as liveries; the Piranha on the Transports' teal engines (Alex). SM_FL_Dagger (/Game/SiriusReborn/Ships/Dagger) through ModelReplacements, built by Scripts/run_update_dagger.sh. Tripo's two exports are one mesh (the prep checks): the pirate paint is the factory livery's skin, the plain gunmetal UNFLAGGED's. M_FL_ShipZoned takes a second skin for that (UnflaggedSkinTex behind the static switch UnflaggedSkinOn, so the other ships sample nothing more; their 21 instances re-hung by run_update_ship_material.sh); hull_import passes it (UnflaggedSkin). The factory livery's label is FACTORY on every ship (its name stays Liberty in saved records). The bent tube Tripo left under the starboard wingtip is removed (Alex). Tripo's glyph boxes painted out of both paints (nose sides, the wings' leading faces and roots); DAGGER on the nose sides, the faction's crest on the wing tops pointing at the nose. Guns: the medium pair hanging under the wingtip caps, the small pair hanging under the nose (its sides have only a 0.3 m upright band, a small gun's base needs 0.72 m), the turret on the top behind the cockpit. The two round nozzles are the engines, the rectangular box between them the afterburner (measured by rays from its frame outward). New engine look Ember: the Liberty jet's materials as instances in dark orange with red sparks, an orange stern light (the charge's blue-violet streak tint is now StreakColor); Teal also for ships/bounty_hunter/bh_fighter. ship_prep passes extra arguments to a prep. Headlight entry. Checked: -FLShipShots -FLShipShotsShip=bw_fighter -FLShipShotsCrest=fc_lr_grp (all views), -FLShipShotsLivery=Unflagged, engines_full (red sparks); bh_fighter engines idle and full (teal rings); li_fighter Unflagged (unchanged). docs: ships.md, hangar.md, progression.md, CREDITS.md, LEGAL_RELEASE.md.

Pirate engines: the Ember look as the Dagger's, no afterburner nozzle of its own (both plumes stretch with it).
- New ship **[Wolfhound](#/wiki/ships/wolfhound)**: Wolfhound after Alex's look: guns two per wing (large on top, medium hanging under its outer part) and the centre gun under the chin's front; the turret forward on the spine between the ducts. Every gun and the turret faces along the ship (Tag FLFacing): the original's hardpoints are rolled, the turret aimed sideways and the upper guns' pitch and yaw were mirrored (-FLTurretTest: all aim together now).

A barrel cut from its own base has no underside where the base met it, so from below its inside showed, from behind, and the hull through it. gun_prep.py plug_under (barrels with a base of their own): on a grid seen from below, each opening (cells whose first face faces up) gets a plate at the height of the underside round it, facing down, in the paint there; the Reaper had one of 1.1 m2 where the column met it, the Barrager none. The bolt: the Lasers pack's Vol 4 #3, its textures only (T_Trail_179 thin wavy core, T_Trail_192 smoky back, gold sparks, a T_Flare007 head: its capsule head T_Arrow_27 would stand upright on a camera-facing flare; its hit T_BurstSmear010 and T_Halo_07), a heavy gun's sizes as the Lavablade's. Checked: -FLWeaponCam on the Starflier with two Reapers beside a Justice. docs: weapons.md (Gun models).
- New weapon **[Scrapstorm](#/wiki/weapons/scrapstorm)**: Barrager (Alex): the Junkers' gatling from Tripo, the whole turret in one model. Its turret line stands on the Barrager's own base; the gun alone is the barrel without it. A small mount, 1.45 m (its barrel is half as tall as long; Alex: the photon rule stays); on the turret 1.15 m (its yoke sits in the front third, and the medium turret allows 0.62 m behind the pivot). The yellow chamber is its strip (Mk I-II blue, the Scrapstorm red). gun_prep.py base_box: Tripo's export is 2399 loose panels, so boxes name the base's pieces (pedestal, the yoke's arms and turntable); turret_trunnion with a base of its own: the base's foot under that point, so the turret pitches on the yoke while the gun alone sits on its lowest point. The mesh bolt for now. Checked: -FLTurretTest on the Defender with Barrager Mk I, II, Scrapstorm, I, II and the Barrager turret (seated, aims and fires, blue and red). docs: weapons.md (Gun models).
- New weapon **[Azrael](#/wiki/weapons/azrael)**: Turret hubs (Alex: gaps between the Death's Hand and the turret base): a gun on a borrowed base is narrower at the pivot than the yoke made for another gun, so its turret barrel gets a hub on each side, a round collar about the pitch axis (it turns with the barrel) from the gun's side into the arm's inner face, measured against the base (gun_prep.py turret_hubs), in the paint at the gun's side. Every gun on a borrowed base rebuilt, its turret barrel only: the Death's Hand and the Starbeam (3 cm each side), the Stunpulse (9-10 cm), the Lavablade (12 cm), the Azrael (12-15 cm: an axle through its narrow rear block). Checked: -FLTurretTest on the Defender with the Azrael turret (the axle from arm to arm). docs: weapons.md (Gun models).
- New weapon **[Vassago](#/wiki/weapons/vassago)**: Azrael (Alex): the Liberty Rogues' laser from Tripo, a small mount (2.2 m: as tall as the small envelope lets it, its cage is chunky) on the Justice's base in its paint. The coil between its two tubes is its strip, glowing in the mark's colour (glow_box: Mk I-III blue, Mk IV amber, the Vassago red); its open cage stays open (keep_holes). gun_prep.py turret_trunnion: on the turret the barrel pitches about its narrow rear block, which sits in the yoke (about the gun's own trunnion the cage stood in the yoke and only a stub showed). plug_holes: the face table refreshed after each hub (a second hole raised). The mesh bolt for now. Checked: -FLTurretTest on the Defender with Azraels Mk I, IV, Vassago, II, III and the Azrael turret (seated, aims and fires, the three glow colours). docs: weapons.md (Gun models).

Its tail makes it tall: 2.45 m is as long as the medium envelope's height lets it, on the turret 1.4 m (the base's pivot 0.81 m up, the turret's top 1.2 m). It sits on its lowest spike under the rear block. The red-orange cells along its barrel are its strip, glowing in the mark's colour (Mk I-III blue, the Tarantula red), told from the X and skull painted in the same hue by glow_box. gun_prep.py: glow_hue from over to runs round through 0 (the strip's hue is 340 .. 30). - **[Rhino](#/wiki/ships/rhino)**: Cargo loads (Alex): a freighter's bays show what it carries, in its commodity's look: containers (general goods), crates (tech, gems, bio, hazards), tanks (liquids, fuel), gas bottles (gases), each piece tinted from its look's palette. Hull sockets FLCargoBay* (the Transport's bays measured by rays, the Rhino's six boxes under its keel hanging) filled in a grid as far as the hold is full (FLCargoLoad.h); this replaces the merged cargo set (the Rhino's ever-same boxes). Traffic freighters and transports carry a run cargo: a good their destination consumes that their origin produces, from FL's markets (UFLCommodityCatalog reads them), loaded through AFLNpcShip::LoadCargo, so it drops as loot; convoys hand theirs over the same way later (trading.md, #165). The player's ship shows its hold's biggest stack. The Transports' crests where Alex marked them (the band behind the canopy, the aft side boxes' panels), the decals numbered over the parts. The Scifi Station masters allowed on instanced meshes (run_update_cargo_usage.sh).
- **[Starflier](#/wiki/ships/starflier)**: The Starflier's chin gun hangs turned over (as the Defender's wings): HpWeapon03 was seated 'under', upright with the gun's top against the nose, so from below it showed its underside. Now 'hang' (roll 180, Tag FLFacing, sockets.json rotations), seated on 60 hits as before. No ship seats 'under' any more, so the seat and its lift are gone: hull_prep.seat_guns takes out, on and hang (another seat stops the prep), SEAT_TAGS / FLTop, scale_out's FLTop height, FFLHardpoint::SeatTopCm, FLHardpoints::GunLiftCm, UFLWeaponCatalog::GunTopCm and the lift in the player's guns, the NPCs' and the hangar view. Only the hull mesh resaved (its sockets); the rebuild's textures restored. Checked: build; -FLShipShots ge_fighter (front, under, side_close); -FLWeaponCam with a Reaper on the chin (its top seen from below, the muzzle forward). docs: ships.md (Starflier, Guns), weapons.md (Mount envelopes).
- **[Defender](#/wiki/ships/defender)**: The Defender's wing guns hang turned over (Alex): HpWeapon03/04 were seated 'under', upright with the gun's top against the wing, so from below a gun showed its underside (the Reaper's, cut from its turret base, was open there). Now 'hang' as the Patriot's pod guns: the gun's base against the wing, turned over (roll 180, Tag FLFacing, sockets.json rotations). Seated on 55 hits, the wing 0.10-0.11 m off the base at most. Only the hull mesh resaved (its sockets); the rebuild's textures restored (this PC's Blender writes other bytes, the same images). Checked: -FLTurretTest on the Defender with Barragers on the wings (their tops seen from below, the muzzles forward). docs: ships.md (Defender).
- **[New York](#/wiki/systems/new-york)**: Nebulae: a coarse bake below Epic. gen_nebula.py also writes <name>_Coarse.vdb (2 x 2 x 2 voxels into one), import_nebula.py imports it as SVT_FL_Nebula_<name>_Coarse, the system profiles name it (<name>_Coarse). AFLNebula::UseBake loads only the bake in use: below Epic (QualityMipBias >= 1) the coarse one at one mip less, the same look as the full bake's mip in 1/8 of the graphics memory; a quality change swaps it (the old one goes at the next garbage collection). M_FL_Nebula's default volume is a coarse one (the default loads wherever the material does). New York at Epic 7.1 GB, High 6.2, Low 6.0 (RTX 4070, 1080p). docs: nebula.md.

**Bugfixes**

- Outfitter: sell loot straight out of the hold.
- Headlights light what is ahead.
- Nebula volume shadow: no gas behind the sun casts.
- Small issues: docking shot, planet view after a rebuild, NPC deaths.
- Ship collision: players bump into NPC and player ships.
- No default post-material frame at a jump's or landing's start.
- Outfitter: storage on the right, the cargo bay in the slots' list.
- Escape pod jobs: no sign-off at the tractor, the result after the landing.
- Guns follow the cursor only in mouse flight.

posts.title: Multiple Ships, Liveries, and redoing it all again
posts.excerpt: Redoing the Starflier, Rhino and Defender, and multiple ships hangar!
posts.body:
# Never enough...

I have this issue that when I do something I demand absolute perfection from myself (and others (the AI lol)) and while it helps with details, it's not a healthy way to go about things :D

Either way, the closest to "perfect" I could've gotten was with Tripo AI modelling which turns images into wireframe models (textured) which I can then port 1:1 into the game.

Hence why now have the new Starflier:

![](images/uploads/2026-10-21-c02340c4-a134-4d0c-85c4-caec41025b44-mvi5j6v6.jpg)

New Rhino:

![](images/uploads/2026-10-21-image-mvi5jnqr.jpg)

And currently rebuilding the Defender:

![](images/uploads/2026-10-21-de60ae2b-6848-4444-a072-e3d82be5bfba-mvi5k7xy.jpg)

Ingame shots in the wiki soon.

Now I wanna redo the stations... man, it's not healthy :D

## Hangars, Multiple Ships and Liveries

Yes, you heard that right, multiple ships being owned will be possible. Well, it already is implemented :D Not a dream, it's already working.

With a storage where you can keep guns and cargo and whatnot.

![](images/uploads/2026-10-21-image-mvi5t2bn.jpg)

Icons are placeholders for now.

![](images/uploads/2026-10-21-image-mvi5tml2.jpg)


![](images/uploads/2026-10-21-image-mvi5u1hw.jpg)
Still gotta fix the nebulas in this one!


I also wanna put more effort into the trading system of the game because I thought the original lacked this a bit.

What else happened:
* Liveries for each ship per player are possible and already work (eventually I wanna add an editor so you can make em yourself)
* Player storage MMO baseline for the servers works
* NPC combat is in
* Friendly NPCs
* Redid the Trade lane VFX
* Missiles, torpedos, shields, all added to the game (no visuals yet)
* Main menu with graphics settings etc
* Redid the badlands nebula (again)
* Lots of bugfixes

posts.title: 0.2.1 we have a working New York and Rhino ALL NEW!
posts.excerpt: New York fully designed (minus some stations), that was some work!
posts.body:
# We have a website! And what a shitshow :D

This is the first post here, hurray! But Im not going to go all teary eyed on it.
Simple, I have been working quite a while on this.
5 days to be precise :D

It's truly remarkable how insanely fast modern AI can do things.

From just an idea a week ago I already have New York fully running in UE, all in a few days.

But this is not to say there wasn't a complete bullshittery going on.

But I have noticed why.

## The prompt is everything

Initially I used Grokbot, which is already a big mistake because Claude Code is SO MUCH better. Light years away.

I still use Grokbot for my local PC stuff. Very good at that and nicely integrated. But for coding, Claude is truly unbeaten.

However, due to that initial prompt that basically just moved the entire OLD way of how New York was built into UE, I was stuck with 20 year old lighting, scripts, and stations.

I only noticed this once I wanted to add better lighting in the nebulas, and it was virtually impossible to get right.

After many thousands of AI tokens I literally told Claude "Do this thing, and forget everything in the project so far, old tech, redo it entirely from scratch with UE" and then it worked.

So I ran an audit on the code and it basically told me it all sucks :D

Thus, the last 3 days I was pretty much busy having it rewrite the entire system from scratch with new coding methods.

## Current Status

Enough bullshitting. We got it going. The Defender is (mostly) done, Rhino is entirely rebuilt (see Screenshot), bunch of stations are here and NPCs fly around.

Concept:

![](images/uploads/2026-10-18-d5156cc7-ddd2-4f27-954c-f856c1827a8a-mve2toxh.jpg)

Ingame:

![](images/uploads/2026-10-18-cargo0-00-hero-mve4kihn.jpg)

![](images/uploads/2026-10-18-cargo1-09-engines-mve4krcg.jpg)

![](images/uploads/2026-10-18-cargo0-08-police-mve4lk6v.jpg)



As you can tell it's not exactly the concept, but I actually like how it came out. Considering this took the AI about 20min to do :D

Also notice the new effect, when your cargo is above 60% it visibly carries cargo in the midsection.

Defender Concept:

![](images/uploads/2026-10-18-927e85be-d4ac-4231-8493-1b7d37a0e806-mve2veru.jpg)


Ingame:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VKFcgTnifbc

This video is already old tho, lots of stuff missing.

Nebulas look fire, mines work, and currently I am building the planet surface for Pittsburgh which will be another shitshow, but here we are :D

-Alex
